_readme: S741 lane 1 (keys): Copper Mountain College's six records S740 left held (History A.A. 43854; Vocational Nursing A.S. 14737 and certificate 20094; Fire Technology A.S. 14751; Elementary Teacher Education A.A.-T 45594; General Business A.S. 14710), each read 2026-11-26 from the catalog's reissue (run 45855512160). This prints every page of the programs section that prints a major total or a degree's minimum units, line for line, so a session can quote each program's own figures (the total it prints, what its printed units add to, and how it words the degree's 60 or 74) for a named gap or a reconcile step, and can read the same words on every other degree page before any step is written. One load. No model call, nothing written.

questions.printed_figures: For each program page: the total it prints for the major, the units printed beside each course and list, and how the page words the degree's units (a minimum, a total, electives as needed).
